# read_B — pp. 48–50 (leaves n49–n51), established from the images

Line counts: p. 48 has five lines (a leaf back, so no ornament). p. 49 has five lines (a leaf front, opens ༄༅༔ ༔). p. 50 has five lines (a leaf back). That makes 15 print lines.
The witness's line breaks match the print on every line (15 of 15).

Method: line bands were located from a row-darkness profile (headlines at y≈135/185/238/288/340 on n49, 160/208/261/313/370 on n50, 134/190/243/297/350 on n51). Each line was cropped in four overlapping segments at ×3, and every doubtful syllable at ×5–×14 (LANCZOS, or NEAREST on greyscale for tsheg questions).

General observation: this block is cramped. At many syllable joins the letters touch at the headline and no tsheg dot can be seen. Where the witness has a tsheg at such a join, and the sense needs it, the witness's tsheg is kept. These places are listed under "Close calls" and are not marked [?]. Where the witness also lacks the tsheg, the print is followed and a fix is proposed, or (49.2) the precedent of read_C 44.3 is followed.

Witness readings checked and confirmed, though they look odd:
- 48.1 ནས་བོད་ལ: ×10, the letter after the tsheg is a bare བ with na-ro, and there is no འ (the print had འབོད at 42.4).
- 48.5 གྷཱིརྟི: ག + ྷ + a-chung with gi-gu, then ར-mgo over ཏ with gi-gu.
- 48.5 ཨཱ་ལོ་ཀེ: ×7. The ཨ has a-chung beneath. ལོ's na-ro is entangled with descenders from 48.4, but it rises to the right like a na-ro. ཀ carries the drengbu.
- 48.5 འཇའ་འོད་ཀྱིས་ཀློང: ×8, a full ས follows ཀྱི.
- 49.1 རྟོགས་བའི: ×6 side by side with 48.2 པའི and 48.1 བུ, it is the one-cell བ.
- 49.1 འཚེར་བ་ཐིག: a tsheg is visible after བ.
- 49.2 ཐད་དཀར (doubled ད); 49.2 གཅིག.
- 49.3 བཀྲག་མད་པ: ×5, there is no vowel over མ or ད. The hook above is the ཉ subscript of 49.2 སྙིང. See misprints.
- 49.3 ཅིག་ཀྱང.
- 49.4 གཤིབས་མར: ×9, what looks like a dot after ག is the left arm of ཤ.
- 50.1 དེ་ཙན: ×9, no tsheg between ཙ and ན.
- 50.2 རིགས་པ: ×8, ག then a full ས.
- 50.3 ཤེས་ན༔: a stroke running under ན to the left is the na-ro of 50.4 མོས, not a zhabs-kyu.
- 50.4 གུས་གྱིས: ×7, the base is ག as in གུས.
- 50.4 མཐའ་ཡས་ཀྱིས་ཐུགས: ས present.
- 50.4 ཡིན་ནོ་མོས་ (no ༔ after ནོ); 50.5 མ་བྲོས་ཅིག.

## [?] (1)

- 49.2 མི་བཟོད་པ[?]་ཙམ་: the letters པ and ཙ are certain (×12). No tsheg can be seen between them, and their heads touch. The witness's བཙམ is no word here. The sense ("so bright the eye cannot bear it") and the print's own form at 43.5 (བལྟ་མི་བཟོད་པ་ཙམ་དུ) require པ་ཙམ. I take the tsheg and mark [?], as in read_C 44.3 ལ[?]་མ. If the drafter prefers the print as cut: `# fix: བཟོད་པཙམ => བཟོད་པ་ཙམ`.

```
# fix: ལ་དྭངྶཔ༔ => ལ་དྭངས་པ༔
# fix: འོངྶ་ཤིང => འོངས་ཤིང
# fix: དེ་ཙན་ཁྱོད => དེ་ཙ་ན་ཁྱོད
# fix: དེ་ལམ་འཇིགས => དེ་ལ་མ་འཇིགས
```
- 49.1→49.2: the line-end contraction དྭངྶ, followed by no tsheg. The next line starts པ༔.
- 49.5: the mid-line subscript-ས contraction.
- 50.1: the print's form elsewhere is དེ་ཙ་ན (35.2, 44.3). Here no tsheg is cut between ཙ and ན.
- 50.1→50.2: there is no tsheg after ལ at the line end. The next line begins མ་འཇིགས.

No པའཾ/ལཾ/ནམཁའ abbreviations occur on these pages.

## Suspected misprints (kept as printed)

1. 49.3 བཀྲག་མད་པ, which should be བཀྲག་མེད་པ. Certainty is high: the vowel is absent on the image, and the phrase is "dull, lustreless". The print has བཀྲག་མེད at 44.1, 49.5/50.1 and 50.5, and the other recension has བཀྲག་མེད་པ. Proposed: `# fix: བཀྲག་མད་པ => བཀྲག་མེད་པ`.
2. 50.2 རིག་པ is spelled རིགས་པ ("awareness"; cf. 44.4 རིག་པ་བྱར་མེད in the print). Certainty is moderate to high on sense. Proposed: `# fix: ཏུ་རིགས་པ་བྱར => ཏུ་རིག་པ་བྱར`. This one is the drafter's choice.
3. 49.2 ཐད་དཀར, which should be ཐད་ཀར (the print has ཐད་ཀར at 43.5; the other recension has ཐད་ཀར). Certainty is moderate. Possible `# fix: ཐད་དཀར་མིག => ཐད་ཀར་མིག`.
4. 48.5 འཇའ་འོད་ཀྱིས་ཀློང and 50.4 མཐའ་ཡས་ཀྱིས་ཐུགས་རྗེ: an instrumental before a noun, where the genitive ཀྱི is meant. The other recension has ཀྱི in both places. This is the same kind of slip as read_C's 43.3. Certainty is moderate. Possible fixes, which are the drafter's choice: `# fix: འོད་ཀྱིས་ཀློང => འོད་ཀྱི་ཀློང` and `# fix: ཡས་ཀྱིས་ཐུགས => ཡས་ཀྱི་ཐུགས`.
5. 48.1 བོད for འབོད: "call" (the print has འབོད at 42.4). བོད is not a misprint; it is a known variant of the verb. Kept, note only.

Not misprints, the print's own spelling: བ for པ (49.1 རྟོགས་བའི); གཅིག/ཅིག for ཞིག (49.2, 49.3); གཤིབས་མར beside 44.1 གཤིབ་མར; the goddess names གྷཱིརྟི and ཨཱ་ལོ་ཀེ.

## Where the other recension differs in sense (print followed)

- 48.1: print ཡི་དྭགས་ལ་འོད་ལམ་གཉིས་ཀྱིས ("the two light-paths, [of the gods] and of the pretas"); other recension …ཡི་དྭགས་ཀྱི་འོད་ལམ་གཉིས་ཀྱིས. The particle differs. ལ is clear on the image.
- 48.5: print ཨཱ་ལོ་ཀེ; other recension ཨཱ་ལོ་མ. Print གྷཱིརྟི; other recension གིརྟི. Print ཀྱིས་ཀློང; other recension ཀྱི་ཀློང.
- 48.5–49.1: print …ཕུང་པོ་གནས་སུ་དག་པ༔ འོད་དམར་པོ… ("the aggregate is purified in its own place; the red light…"); other recension …གནས་སུ་དག་པའི་འོད་དམར་པོ ("the red light of the purified aggregate"). The syntax differs.
- 49.1: print བརྒྱན་པ; other recension སྤྲས་པ. Same sense.
- 49.4: print དེ་ལ་དགའ་བར་མ་བྱེད་ཅིག; other recension དེ་ལ་མི་དགའ་བར་གྱིས་ཤིག. Same sense. The print adds ཁྱོད before འདོད་ཆགས.
- 49.5: print ཁྱོད་སྐྲག་པ…བྲོས་སུ་འོངས་ཤིང; other recension སྐྲག་པ…བྲོས་སུ་འོང་ཞིང. Same.
- 50.1: print བསྐྱེད་ནས་འོང་གིས; other recension སྐྱེས་ནས་འོང་གི. Same.
- **50.2: the print lacks a whole stretch.** After …ཞོག་ཅིག༔ the other recension continues ཡང་ན་དེ་ལ་དད་པ་དང་མོས་པ་དུང་དུང་གྱིས་ཤིག༔ ཁྱོད་རང་གི་རང་མདངས་སུ་ངོ་ཤེས་ན་ནི༔ མོས་གུས་མ་བྱས་སྨོན་ལམ་མ་བཏབ་ཀྱང་སྐུ་དང་འོད་ཟེར་ཐམས་ཅད་ཁྱོད་རང་དང་ before དབྱེར་མེད་དུ་ཐིམ. The print goes straight from ཞོག་ཅིག༔ to དབྱེར་མེད་དུ་ཐིམ་ནས་སངས་རྒྱས་པར་འགྱུར་རོ༔. The print's own parallel for day three (44.4–45.1) has the full passage. The print's text still reads ("rest…; [you] dissolve inseparably and become a buddha"), but the condition "if you recognise…" is missing. It may be a block-carver's omission. Print followed; worth a note.
- 50.2: print ངང་དུ་གློད; other recension ངང་ལ་ཀློད. Same.
- 50.4: print ཐུགས་རྗེའི་འོད་ཟེར་གྱི་ལྕགས་ཀྱུ ("the hook of the rays of compassion"); other recension ཐུགས་རྗེ་ལྕགས་ཀྱུའི་འོད་ཟེར ("the rays of the compassion-hook"). Close in sense.
- 50.5: print མ་བྲོས་ཅིག; other recension མ་བྲོས་ཤིག. Same.
